rejected_cache_trials.identity: Each retained patch independently applied in memory to the frozen baseline matches its reported candidate source hash.

limits: Descriptive paired medians only; four pairs per group, no product performance qualification.
Release wins do not negate Arena mixed/tiny and forward counterevidence.
Concurrent mixed groups have differing peak backing; API workload and byte oracle match, scheduling and capacity trajectory are uncontrolled.
x64 Release sizeof equality is not metadata total, Android layout, RSS or memory-saving evidence.
ASan is not TSan, proof of all interleavings or leak freedom; uncertain ownership is quarantined.
